data.name: Nazzar
data.gender_notes: Nazzar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘nazara’, meaning ‘to observe’ or ‘to see’. In Islamic history, Prophet Ibrahim (AS) was called ‘Nazzar’ because of his keen observation and deep understanding of God’s signs. The name Nazzar carries the meaning “Observer, Seer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazzar usually hope their child will grow to embody observer, seer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies one who observes God’s signs and lives in accordance with His guidance.
data.etymology: Nazzar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Observer, Seer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazzar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: نظر
in_arabic.long_meaning: نظر هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ن-ظ-ر' والذي يعني النظر أو الإبصار. في اللغة العربية، يعني النظر إلى شيء بإمعان واهتمام. وفي السياق الإسلامي، يُعتبر النظر إلى الخالق أو إلى الحقائق الروحية بمعنى أعمق.

in_urdu.name: نظار
in_urdu.meaning: واضح نظر رکھنے والا، بصیرت رکھنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: نظار نام عربی جڑ 'ن-ظ-ر' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے دیکھنا یا نظر کرنا۔ اردو میں، اس کا مطلب ہے کسی چیز کو غور سے دیکھنا یا سمجھنا۔ اسلامی تقليد میں، یہ نام روحاني بصیرت یا اندرونی نظر کی علامت ہو سکتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नज़्ज़ार
in_hindi.long_meaning: नज़्ज़ार नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'न-ज़-र' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है देखना या दृष्टि। हिंदी में, इसका अर्थ है स्पष्ट दृष्टि या बुद्धिमत्ता। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक जागरूकता या उच्च समझ का प्रतीक हो सकता है।

in_pashto.name: نظار
in_pashto.long_meaning: نظار د عربي جڑ 'ن-ظ-ر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده ليدنې یا پوهېدنه. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د ژور ليدنې یا روحاني بصیرت د سمبول په توګه کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Nazzar
in_english.meaning: One who looks or gazes with attention
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nazzar originates from the Arabic root 'n-ż-r', meaning to look or gaze. In Islamic tradition, it signifies one who possesses insight or inner sight. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing spiritual awareness and keen perception.

This name also symbolizes a person with a keen sense of sight and an astute observer of the world around them.

This name serves as a reminder to always look for God’s presence in our lives and to observe the world with a discerning eye, seeking knowledge and wisdom from every experience. Furthermore, Nazzar encourages us to be attentive to our inner selves and to reflect upon our thoughts, emotions, and actions, striving to maintain a strong connection with God.
